facts.text: Colgate requires and guarantees on-campus student housing for all four years.

sources.title: Housing Selection | Colgate University
sources.quote: We're committed to a residential learning environment that requires and guarantees on-campus student housing for all four years.

facts.text: In Colgate's Core Curriculum, students take Core Conversations, a course centered on five shared texts across cultures and eras.

sources.title: Core Curriculum | Colgate University
sources.quote: Core Conversations is a course focused on five shared texts — defined broadly to include diverse intellectual and creative expressions across cultures and time periods

facts.text: All first-year and sophomore students live within their assigned Residential Commons.

sources.title: Residence Halls | Colgate University
sources.quote: Throughout the first two years on campus, students live within the living and learning community of their Residential Commons.
